review.evidence: Compared the whole 2026-10-28 source with the guide after the author's fixes. Intro and best practices (Swipe between pages, no redefined Dock or Mission Control gestures, one experience across inputs, pointer reveal of minimized controls, modifier-drag consistency) are kept. iPadOS keeps the context-adaptive pointer, band selection, the arrow default pointer, Liquid Glass highlight and lift, hover, the new effect-selection rules, 12 pt / 24 pt padding, contiguous bar hit regions, accessories with UIPointerAccessory and all customizing rules. macOS keeps every mouse/trackpad action and, after the fix, every finger combination (Mission Control, lookup, App Exposé, Apps, Show Desktop) and force click's Quick Look or lookup window; the #Pointers table covers all 32 pointers with AppKit and SwiftUI APIs, and the frame-resize row now gives the minimum/maximum case as an example. The new touch support for hidden controls and visionOS are kept. Removed source content (Pointer magnetism, the circle pointer, lift corner radius, iPadOS 15, Launchpad, Videos) is gone. I found no remaining omission or wrong number.
